# SwagLabs Test Coverage Report

**Ground Truth:** `swaglab.md` (82 test cases across 9 modules)
**Generated Tests:** `gpt-5-mini/agent/Swaglab-openai-gpt-5-mini-tests.md` (92 test cases across 9 modules)
**Generated by:** openai/gpt-5-mini | **Approach:** Agent | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

### 1. Login

**Ground Truth:** 15 tests | **Generated:** 15 tests

**Coverage: ⚠️ Partial**

The generated tests cover:
- Valid login with standard_user (TC-001 ≈ SL-LOGIN-001) ✅
- Invalid user (TC-003, TC-010 ≈ SL-LOGIN-004) ✅
- Invalid password (TC-003, TC-010 ≈ SL-LOGIN-005) ✅
- Empty username (TC-004, TC-007 ≈ SL-LOGIN-006) ✅
- Empty password (TC-005, TC-008 ≈ SL-LOGIN-007) ✅
- Both fields empty (TC-006, TC-009 ≈ SL-LOGIN-008) ✅
- Locked out user (TC-002, TC-011 ≈ SL-LOGIN-009) ✅
- Username with leading/trailing spaces (TC-012 ≈ SL-LOGIN-010) ✅
- Case sensitivity (TC-013 ≈ SL-LOGIN-011) ✅

#### ❌ Missing Scenarios

| GT ID | Missing Scenario | Reason |
|-------|-----------------|--------|
| SL-LOGIN-002 | **Login page elements displayed** | The agent jumps straight to authentication actions and fails to verify static UI elements (username field, password field, login button, accepted usernames list). |
| SL-LOGIN-003 | **Login with each valid user type** | The agent heavily tests standard_user and locked_out_user, but completely ignores problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, and visual_user. |
| SL-LOGIN-012 | **Password field masking** | The agent tests functionality but lacks a UI/UX test to ensure the password input is masked (type="password"). |
| SL-LOGIN-013 | **Error message dismissible** | The agent tests error occurrences but fails to test if clicking the "X" on the error banner successfully dismisses it. |
| SL-LOGIN-014 | **Tab navigation** | Missing keyboard accessibility test for tabbing between fields. |
| SL-LOGIN-015 | **Enter key submission** | Missing keyboard accessibility test for submitting the form using the Enter key. |

#### ➕ Extra Scenarios (in Generated, not in GT)
- TC-014: Password field accepting emoji/unicode characters.
- TC-015: Rapid double-click on the Login button.

#### 🧠 Business Logic Comparison
**Core Logic:** Multi-persona authentication (standard, locked_out, problem, glitch, error, visual), strict field validation, and error messaging dismissibility.
- **[Captured]** Basic authentication routing (valid, invalid, empty).
- **[Missed]** Multi-persona access (problem, glitch, error, visual, locked_out).
- **[Missed]** UI/UX Accessibility features (keyboard nav, static layout, error dismiss, masking).
- **[Captured]** Strict field validation (space trimming, case sensitivity, bounds).
- **[Extra]** Password field accepting emoji/unicode characters, Rapid double-click on Login.

#### ❌ Missing Scenarios

| GT ID | Missing Scenario | Reason |
|-------|-----------------|--------|
| SL-INV-001 | **Products displayed** | No explicit check that the inventory correctly renders a list of 6 products with titles, descriptions, and prices. |
| SL-INV-003 | **Add multiple products** | The agent tests single item addition but does not test adding multiple items to verify cumulative badge counts. |
| SL-INV-006 | **Sort Z-A** | The agent tests the default A-Z sort but neglects the reverse alphabetical option. |
| SL-INV-007 | **Sort Price low to high** | Entirely missing price-based sorting behavior. |
| SL-INV-008 | **Sort Price high to low** | Entirely missing descending price sort behavior. |
| SL-INV-010 | **Cart icon navigation** | The agent tests adding items but never tests clicking the cart icon to navigate to the Shopping Cart page. |
| SL-INV-012 | **Product images displayed** | Missing UI assertion for images. |
| SL-INV-013 | **Price formatting** | Missing validation that prices are formatted with the '$' symbol and two decimal places. |
| SL-INV-014 | **Cart badge visibility** | Missing UI check that the cart badge is completely invisible when 0 items are in the cart. |
| SL-INV-015 | **Cart badge updates** | Failed to explicitly verify real-time badge integer increments. |
| SL-INV-016 | **Sort dropdown options** | Missing check that the dropdown contains exactly the 4 required sort options. |
| SL-INV-017 | **Hamburger menu visible** | Menu visibility and toggle interaction is not tested. |

#### ➕ Extra Scenarios (in Generated, not in GT)

- TC-007: Attempt to add product when already in cart.
- TC-008: Double click Add button.
- TC-009: Double click Remove button.
- TC-010: Rapid Add button clicking.

#### 🧠 Business Logic Comparison
**Core Logic:** Complete product listing (6 items), Add/Remove toggle states, real-time cart badge mathematics, and comprehensive 4-way sorting.
- **[Captured]** Basic single-item state mutation (add/remove) and detail navigation.
- **[Missed]** Complete visual rendering (6 products, image formatting, static UI options).
- **[Missed]** Comprehensive 4-way sorting (A-Z, Z-A, Low-High, High-Low).
- **[Missed]** Real-time cart badge mathematics (multi-item increments, empty invisibility).
- **[Extra]** Out-of-bound array indexing, rapid toggle, session block verification.

### Generated Tests Strengths
The Agent approach generates extremely resilient tests focusing heavily on **interaction edges** (rapid clicking, double submission, browser back navigation, idempotency) and **security/authentication checks**. However, because the agent explores paths by interacting with elements rather than analyzing static business requirements, it is highly blind to **mathematical business logic** (tax, sorting, multi-item addition) and **visual consistency** (data matching across pages, static images, formatting).
